title: The first occupations of western Europe: dispersals and population dynamics in the early to middle Pleistocene
core_idea: Study the early to middle Pleistocene occupations of western Europe as part of the broader Out of Africa process, focusing on dispersal events and population dynamics and addressing the documented chronological gap between early occupations in Asia and those in western Europe.
tldr: Investigate how dispersals and population dynamics shaped the first Pleistocene occupations of western Europe within the wider Out of Africa framework, and why a chronological gap exists relative to Asia.
